items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I really enjoyed working with him... we had a lot of fun together... this tour.

ctx.x: The conductor was Don Yapp. He was from Hawaii, and he was the conductor, and he was a wonderful guy -- I really enjoyed working with him, we had a lot of fun together. And we would go to, like, Portland, Oregon, after we left Detroit, started out on the west coast, and we would play Portland, Oregon, and from there we would go to San Francisco, and then to Los Angeles, and then to Dallas, Texas -- and come north to Chicago. We played in New York
state and we'd come down to Florida, and the show would probably end back in Detroit. And this would last for 6 weeks, this tour.
